goal: Port lexical.verbosity to v3 as structure-lexical.verbosity: Corpus-altitude, consumes Lexical.over(corpus).named_entities/token_locations/frequency_head. Ships ONLY the scope-leak case (entity name tokens with high cross-file spread + frequency-head membership = name compensating for a missing namespace) as a directed NARROW_SCOPE WARNING verdict; CUTS the legacy local-verbosity NOTE_PATTERN case (a non-actionable 'maybe just descriptive' style note, per structural-not-style). Language-id prefix discount derived from corpus realm languages. Legacy verbosity.py as oracle.

summary.title: Port lexical.verbosity (scope-leak verdict only)
summary.what: Corpus-altitude lexical.verbosity over Lexical.over(corpus). Emits a directed NARROW_SCOPE WARNING verdict only for the scope-leak case (over-long name + high-spread + frequency-head tokens). Cut the legacy local-verbosity NOTE_PATTERN note. Registry 19; 4 tests.
summary.why: The scope-leak case is the structural lexical-degradation signal (name compensating for missing scope). The local-verbosity note is non-actionable style and cut per structural-not-style.

decisions.chose: Ship only scope-leak; cut local verbosity
decisions.rationale: Local long-but-scoped names are not defects slop can claim; only the high-spread scope-leak case is structural.
rejected: Port both cases (the NOTE_PATTERN case is style noise)
